name: Thracian Lion
subtitle: Hellenic Beast
description: Protect your pride and Taunt enemies to attack you as thrash through enemies.
lore: A fearsome predator stalking the wilds of Olympus, the mighty Thracian lion is a symbol of kingly and divine power. Possessing fur the color of burnished gold, the lion uses both stealth and the element of surprise to hunt, springing upon its prey with a heart-stopping roar. It is said that kings capture and train these beasts to stand guard over palaces and tombs.

leader_bonus.scope: In all battles for allies with a Fire element.

divinity_generator: Gain [10] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

Skill 2 (Fire Strike) gains its Awakening Bonus.
Skill 3 (Flame Burst) gains its Awakening Bonus.
